newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle not fully established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle not fully established - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow on Wednesday morning following the large movement on Tuesday, USDA said. Prices on slaughter steers and heifers live basis not fully established, dressed basis near steady.
Buyer inquiry and demand moderate , seller interest limited as most have sold their showlists this week, however, a few feedyards still have cattle they wish to sell.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs 105.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs few 65.50 delivered. Dressed basis - 105.00. Sales confirmed - 1,500 For the week - 107,300
